CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steve Talt, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108
Mario Rueda, Acting City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, JULY 28, 2023 AT 8:30 AM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108
  AND
  220 TONSET ROAD
  ORLEANS, MA 02653

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85638871973
  Meeting ID: 856 3887 1973

AGENDA – JULY 28, 2023  PAGE 1 of 4
   Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 856 3887 1973

How to offer public comment from home:
  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time, and previously
  distributed public comment will be noted. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will
  be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.

  Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place
limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

AGENDA – JULY 28, 2023  PAGE 2 of 4
   NEW BUSINESS

1.  APPROVAL OF THE COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT SCHEDULE
  OF FEES FOR SERVICE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 AND ADOPTION OF
  RESOLUTION NO. R-23-25 AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. R-21-10 TO
  INCLUDE THE COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT’S SCHEDULE OF
  FEES  FOR  SERVICE  FOR  FY  2023-24

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Community
  Services Department’s Schedule of Fees for Service for FY 2023-24 and adopt
  Resolution No. R-23-25 amending Resolution No. R-21-10 to include the Community
  Services Department’s Schedule of Fees for Service for FY 2023-24.

  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be: “I move to approve the Community Services Department’s Schedule of Fees for
  Service for FY 2023-24 and adopt Resolution No. R-23-25 amending Resolution No. R-
  21-10 to include the Community Services Department’s Schedule of Fees for Service
  for FY 2023-24.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

2.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-23-1405 (SECOND READING)
  AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 23.03.01 TO IMPLEMENT
  SENATE BILL 6 AND ASSEMBLY BILL 2011 BY ALLOWING
  MULTIFAMILY DEVELOPMENT IN THE C-1 COMMERCIAL ZONE WHEN
  THOSE DEVELOPMENTS MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE
  GOVERNMENT CODE AND REVISING THE APPLICABILITY OF THE
  OBJECTIVE  DESIGN  STANDARDS  IN  THE  C-1  ZONE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Ordinance No. O-23-1405. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to waive full reading and introduce by title only Ordinance No. O-23- 1405, an
  Ordinance of the San Marino City Council amending San Marino Municipal Code Section
  23.03.01 to implement Senate Bill 6 and Assembly Bill 2011 by allowing multifamily
  development in the C-1 Commercial Zone when those developments meet the
  requirements of the Government Code and revising the applicability of the objective
  design standards in the C-1 Zone.”

3.  APPROVAL TO PURCHASE FIRE DEPARTMENT BATTALION VEHICLE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the purchase of one
  2024 Chevrolet Silverado from National Auto Fleet Group in the amount of $75,132.45.

  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

AGENDA – JULY 28, 2023  PAGE 4 of 4
   “I move to approve the procurement and authorize the City Manager to execute a
  purchase agreement of one 2024 Chevrolet Silverado from National Auto Fleet Group
  in the amount of $75,132.45.”

 4.  APPROVAL OF PURCHASE OF TWO ELECTRIC RIDING MOWERS FOR
  THE PARKS AND PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $58,790 AND APPROPRIATION OF $11,290 FROM THE AIR DISTRICT
  FUND  FOR  THE  PURCHASE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the purchase of two
  electric riding mowers from La Verne Power Equipment, Inc., in the amount of $58,790,
  and authorize the appropriation of $11,290 into the Air District Fund Account # 212-
  00-3203-0080.

  “I move to approve the purchase of two electric riding mowers from La Verne Power
  Equipment, Inc., in the amount of $58,790, and authorize the appropriation of $11,290
  into the Air District Fund Account # 212-00-3203-0080.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
